response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level breadth, deep distributed/high-throughput systems experience (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic), and is currently working in an AI-native engineering environment building agentic tooling and MCP frameworks, which aligns well with the role's core mindset. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have, and there's limited explicit detail on stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, or agile ceremony participation, making this a moderate-fit candidate worth a screening call to probe the Python gap.
strengths: Strong distributed systems background with real high-throughput, low-latency production experience (millions of requests/sec)
Currently hands-on with AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows (MCP code generators) at a staff level
Broad systems thinking demonstrated across embedded, mobile, web, backend, and infra domains over a long career
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being an explicit must-have
Little explicit evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management or product-engineering bridging
No clear mention of on-call/incident response ownership or agile/scrum ceremony experience

key_factors.factor: Deep high-throughput distributed systems track record
